rows.ARS:
Red blend Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Brocéliande ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Michel Adam (France, 2000).
Introduced in France by NIRP International / Lux Riviera in 2000 as 'Brocéliande'.
rows.Bloom: Red and white, stripes. Strong fragrance. up to 55 petals. Average diameter 5". Very large, very full (41+ petals), borne mostly solitary bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Upright. Large, glossy, dark green, dense, leathery foliage.

Height: 35" to 47" (90 to 120cm). Width: 20" to 2' (50 to 60cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Can be used for landscape.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
